東京ヴェルディは、アウェイでまだ一度もスコアを動かしていない

Before Urawa Reds vs Tokyo Verdy on September 19, 2026, this essay looks at Verdy through current results and primary sources. They are 0-4-3 with three goals and nine conceded. All three league goals came from registered defenders, while both away matches ended 0-0. The 21-shot game against JEF Chiba, the arrivals of Kazunari Ichimi and Kanya Fujimoto, and injuries including Koki Morita suggest a team trying to rebuild its attack without throwing away its defensive base.
